title: Executive order "Inaugurating the Era of Super Intelligence" signed
summary: US federal agencies are told to replace "artificial intelligence" and "AI" with "super intelligence" and "SI" in official communications. Statutes and contracts are not rewritten.

title: Six AI companies sign the voluntary White House Accord on Super Intelligence
summary: Anthropic, Google, Meta, Nvidia, OpenAI and xAI commit to internal oversight, independent audits and board review. The accord carries no legal penalties.
